# Master Services Agreement

This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is made as of February 1, 2026
between Globex Corporation and Soylent LLC.

## 1. Definitions

"Confidential Information" means any non-public information disclosed by a party. The
Confidential Information is protected under Section 2.
"Severance Fee" means the amount payable on early termination.

## 2. Services

Globex Corporation shall deliver the services described in {{statement_of_work}}. Payment
follows the schedule in Section 5.2. Globex Corp. may use subcontractors.

## 4. Payment

Invoices are due within thirty days, as detailed in Section 9.3.

## 5. Confidentiality

"Confidential Information" means information that a party marks confidential. The parties
shall protect Confidential Information as set out in Section 5.2.

## 6. Term

This Agreement is effective as of February 1, 2026 and expires on January 1, 2026.
